shorts_extract.hook: Why you forget twelve finished chores yet wake up at 3 AM replaying one unreturned message—traced to a 1920s Berlin cafe waiter and 164 interrupted puzzles.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Bluma Zeigarnik (1927, University of Berlin): sweeping half of 18–22 hands-on tasks into a drawer mid-stream boosted free recall 1.9x over finished tasks regardless of clock time.
shorts_extract.twist: Once paid or written into a concrete tomorrow-morning calendar slot, your frontal scratchpad silences the open loop in 60 seconds.
